userStories.title: Add awaiting to node status enums and projector
userStories.description: As a workflow observer, I want node status enums and the state projector to support awaiting, so that a paused-on-ask node is truthfully projected as awaiting instead of running or completed.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/schemas/workflow-run.ts adds 'awaiting' to workflowStepStatusSchema and nodeStateSchema while keeping workflowRunStatusSchema and nodeOutputSchema free of awaiting.
Compile-time type assertion confirms NodeOutput['state'] extends NodeState without requiring NodeState to equal NodeOutput['state'].
packages/workflows/src/schemas.test.ts verifies nodeStateSchema and workflowStepStatusSchema parse 'awaiting' while nodeOutputSchema rejects it.
RetryNodeProjection.state in packages/workflows/src/retry-state.ts uses NodeState instead of NodeOutput['state'].
projectLatestEffectiveNodeStates accepts an optional pending array of { node_id: string; status: string }.
A node_awaiting event sets the node projection state to 'awaiting' without writing output.
An interaction_resolved event does not change node state and never completes the node.
Pending rows with status === 'pending' overlay 'awaiting' onto a running node, while answered pending rows do not overlay awaiting.
packages/workflows/src/retry-state.test.ts passes all new projection tests, and existing retry/step tests remain green.

userStories.title: Make Ask pause optional-approval and idempotent
userStories.description: As a workflow engine operator, I want pauseWorkflowRun to support Ask pause without writing metadata.approval, so that dynamic questions pause the run without touching the declared-gate approval slot.
acceptanceCriteria: IWorkflowStore.pauseWorkflowRun in packages/workflows/src/store.ts marks approvalContext as optional: approvalContext?: ApprovalContext.
When approvalContext is undefined, packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts updates status = 'paused' without json-merging metadata.approval or any other metadata.
Ask pause is idempotent: if the UPDATE matches zero rows but the run is already paused, pauseWorkflowRun succeeds without throwing.
If the UPDATE matches zero rows and the run status is not paused (e.g. completed, failed), pauseWorkflowRun throws the existing not-running error.
When approvalContext is provided, the existing gate pause path preserves byte-for-byte behavior: writing metadata.approval with explicit-null subfields and requiring running status.
Ask pause does not emit approval_pending.
packages/core/src/db/workflows.test.ts passes tests for metadata-free Ask pause, idempotency when already paused, error on completed run, and gate pause regression.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 2 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-pause-without-approval-slot.md:507-600. Modify packages/workflows/src/store.ts, packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts, and packages/core/src/db/workflows.test.ts.

userStories.title: Add remote_agent_pending_interactions additively
userStories.description: As a workflow developer, I want an additive remote_agent_pending_interactions table in SQLite and PostgreSQL, so that structured pending asks can be persisted durably.
acceptanceCriteria: migrations/000_combined.sql defines application table 23 remote_agent_pending_interactions with exactly 12 columns: id (UUID PK), workflow_run_id (FK cascade), node_id, tool_use_id, kind (CHECK ask|permission), status (CHECK pending|answered|purged), envelope (JSONB), answer (JSONB nullable), provider_session_id, created_at, resolved_at, resolved_by.

PostgreSQL migration includes named unique constraint uq_pending_interactions_run_tool_use on (workflow_run_id, tool_use_id), table comment beside CREATE TABLE, and column comments in trailing comments section without redundant standalone indexes.
packages/core/src/db/adapters/sqlite.ts mirrors table 23 in createSchema with TEXT types, matching CHECKs, named unique constraint, and ON DELETE CASCADE; does not add to migrateColumns.
packages/core/src/db/adapters/sqlite.test.ts raises MIN_NON_AUTH_COLUMNS parity floor from 169 to 181 and verifies table columns, constraints, unique index, and foreign key cascade deletion.
bun run generate:bundled-schema regenerates packages/core/src/db/bundled-schema.generated.ts without unexpected changes, and bundled-schema.test.ts passes.
AGENTS.md documents 23 application tables and Better Auth tables 24-27.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 3 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-pause-without-approval-slot.md:602-690. Modify migrations/000_combined.sql, packages/core/src/db/adapters/sqlite.ts, packages/core/src/db/adapters/sqlite.test.ts, AGENTS.md, and run bun run generate:bundled-schema.

userStories.title: Insert and list pending rows in transaction with node_awaiting
userStories.description: As a workflow executor, I want to insert pending interactions and emit node_awaiting in a single database transaction, so that pending asks and audit events are committed atomically.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.ts exports insertPendingInteractionSchema using pendingInteractionSchema.pick({...}).strict() with caller-assigned fields: workflow_run_id, node_id, tool_use_id, kind, envelope, provider_session_id.
insertPendingInteractionSchema rejects non-empty status and empty provider_session_id; tests pass in packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.test.ts.
packages/providers/src/types.ts exports AskHumanAwaitingError, AskHumanNoStarterError, and AskHumanControlError.
packages/core/src/schemas/pending-interaction.ts aliases the workflow schema, and packages/core/src/schemas/index.ts re-exports it.

packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.ts implements insertPendingInteraction in withTransaction: row lock via FOR UPDATE on PostgreSQL, throws AskHumanNoStarterError if run user_id is null, inserts pending row, calls insertWorkflowEvent for event_type 'node_awaiting' with data { node_id, tool_use_id, kind }, returns canonically parsed row.
An atomic rollback trigger aborting event inserts rolls back the pending interaction insert completely.

listPendingInteractions returns all rows for a run ordered by created_at ASC, id ASC; malformed JSON throws PendingInteractionCorruptRowError containing only row id in message without logging payload.
packages/core/src/db/index.ts exports workflowPendingInteractionDb and direct functions.
packages/core/package.json adds workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts to test suite, and tests pass.

userStories.title: Convert questions[] and preserve branded tool errors at converter boundary
userStories.description: As a provider bridge implementer, I want Claude and Pi native tool converters to support nested questions[] and propagate branded control errors, so that AskHuman input schemas are validated and control signals escape the agent loop.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/types.ts defines NativeToolHandlerContext with optional toolUseId and sessionId, and updates NativeTool.handler signature to (input: Record<string, unknown>, context?: NativeToolHandlerContext) => Promise<string>.
Claude buildArchonMcpServer and Pi buildPiNativeToolDefinitions accept runtime hooks (contextFor/onControlError, sessionId/onControlError).
Claude and Pi native tool converters recursively accept array-of-strings and array-of-objects schemas, enforcing minItems: 1 and required fields for ASK_HUMAN_INPUT_SCHEMA.
Converters reject unsupported types (e.g. numbers) with fail-fast unsupported type errors.
When NativeTool.handler throws AskHumanAwaitingError or AskHumanNoStarterError, onControlError receives the instance and the tool callback rejects with the exact same instance.
Normal tool errors are not reported to onControlError and remain standard SDK tool errors.
packages/providers/src/claude/native-tools.test.ts and packages/providers/src/community/pi/native-tools.test.ts pass all schema and control error tests.

userStories.title: Make Claude abort and reject with the same Ask control error
userStories.description: As a Claude provider maintainer, I want Claude sendQuery to capture the real SDK tool id and session id, abort in-flight queries on AskHuman, and rethrow the branded error instance without retrying.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/claude/provider.ts captures the first non-empty session_id from SDK raw messages.
A composed PreToolUse hook captures the real tool_use_id for mcp__archon__AskHuman and clears it after consumption so stale IDs are never reused.
The MCP tool callback passes the real toolUseId and sessionId into the handler context and never invents a fabricated replacement ID.
When an AskHumanControlError is caught by the runtime bridge, the attempt AbortController is aborted.
sendQuery rethrows the exact same stored control error instance before generic abort classification, rate-limit classification, or retry logic.
Checking the control slot after clean iterator exits prevents SDK swallowing from turning an Ask into a success.
packages/providers/src/claude/provider.test.ts passes tests verifying error identity, abort signal, single query execution (no retry), and real context parameters.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 9 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-pause-without-approval-slot.md:1119-1176. Modify packages/providers/src/claude/provider.ts and packages/providers/src/claude/provider.test.ts.

userStories.title: Make Pi abort and reject with the same Ask control error
userStories.description: As a Pi provider maintainer, I want Pi sendQuery to capture call ID and session ID, abort the agent session on AskHuman, and rethrow the branded error instance even if Pi converts tool throws internally.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/pi/provider.ts passes _toolCallId and session.sessionId to NativeTool.handler context.
Pi runtime onControlError records the exact AskHumanControlError instance and calls session.abort().
After bridgeSession returns or throws, sendQuery checks the stored control error and rethrows the original instance.
Internal tool error conversion by Pi's prompt loop does not prevent the branded error from rejecting sendQuery.
Normal tool errors continue to follow standard Pi tool-error conversion and do not abort the session.
packages/providers/src/community/pi/provider.test.ts passes tests for error identity, session.abort() call, single session creation, and normal error handling.

userStories.title: Inject AskHuman, persist, throw, and pause without completing the node
userStories.description: As a workflow executor, I want command, prompt, and loop nodes on askHuman-capable providers to receive the AskHuman tool, persist questions, and cleanly pause the DAG when invoked.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/ask-human.ts implements createAskHumanTool with name 'AskHuman', ASK_HUMAN_INPUT_SCHEMA, Zod-based questions validation, toolUseId/sessionId requirement, insertPendingInteraction call, workflow.ask_pending log (ids only), and throwing AskHumanAwaitingError.
packages/workflows/src/ask-human.test.ts passes in packages/workflows/package.json as its own Bun test invocation.

packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts injects AskHuman into command, prompt, and loop nodes only when getProviderCapabilities(provider).askHuman is true, omitting it for bash, script, approval, plannotator_gate, and loop_group containers.

On catching AskHumanAwaitingError, dag-executor calls pauseWorkflowRun(runId) with no approval context, sets transcript lifecycle awaiting, emits live node_awaiting, skips node_completed and node_failed events, and returns { state: 'completed', output } to cleanly halt DAG between layers.
Loop nodes preserve accumulated text and usage without calling failLoopIteration when paused on Ask.
AskHumanNoStarterError and database persist failures follow the standard node-failed path and do not pause the run.
packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.test.ts passes all injection, pause, lifecycle, and event-omission tests.

userStories.title: Reject AskHuman on unsupported providers at run start and keep chat clean
userStories.description: As a workflow operator, I want workflows specifying allowed_tools: [AskHuman] on unsupported providers to fail preflight immediately before turn 1, while chat remains free of AskHuman.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts implements collectAskHumanUnsupportedProviders inspecting command, prompt, and loop nodes (including nested loop_group bodies) using WorkflowModelScope.
Preflight normalizes allowed_tools entries with entry.split('(')[0].trim() to match AskHuman, mcp__archon__AskHuman, and specifier forms like AskHuman(allow).

If allowed_tools references AskHuman and the resolved provider has askHuman === false, executeDagWorkflow throws before any node execution: AskHuman is not supported by provider '<id>'. Remove AskHuman from allowed_tools, or use claude or pi.
The same workflow without AskHuman in allowed_tools starts normally with no Ask tool injected.
Preflight runs unconditionally before node 1 and reuses WorkflowModelScope for container preflight.
